title: Fire Safety Engineer
desc:
About the Company
"Would you like to take your place in Allianz, which is the choice of those who care for tomorrow?”
The Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers with more than 100 million private and corporate customers in more than 70 countries. We are proud to be the Worldwide Insurance Partner of the Olympic & Paralympic Movements from 2021 until 2028 and to be recognized as one of the industry leaders in the Dow Jones Sustainability Index.
We believe in fostering an inclusive workforce and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. To fulfill our commitment to equal opportunities, gender equity, and balanced gender representation, Allianz Türkiye has achieved the globally recognized EDGE certification.
At Allianz Turkey we proud to be recognized as a “Great Place To Work” and chosen as a top company of business world at 8 times by Capital Magazine.
Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
Join us and together, let’s care for tomorrow.
What do we expect you to bring?
Participates in the testing, training, and consulting services of the Allianz Technical Fire Department.
Follows up on business processes under their responsibility and conducts sales and technical meetings with clients.
Participates in the organization of training programs in the field of fire safety.
Responsible for preparing fire risk analysis reports for businesses and presenting them to clients.
Responsible for the design, engineering, and compliance checks of fire protection system projects.
Participates in the field inspection, functional testing, and commissioning controls of fire protection systems.
Participates in the testing and reporting processes at the fire response test laboratory.
How can you make an impact?
Graduated from Engineering or Architecture Faculties of universities (Preferably Architect, Mechanical Engineer, or Civil Engineer)
Minimum 5 years of experience in the field of fire safety
Experience in the design, installation, and operation of active and passive fire protection systems
Proficient in the "Regulation on Protection of Buildings from Fire"
Knowledge of internationally recognized standards and guidelines in the field of fire safety (NFPA, EN, FM, etc.)
Minimum B1 level English proficiency.
Having knowledge in Artificial Intelligence (AI) development, Data Analytics, Data Intelligence, AI/Data Strategy, and ChatGPT.
What we will offer you?
Company
Working in Green certificated & pet friendly Allianz Tower / Allianz Kampüs with modern work spaces, gym & social areas.
Working in agile, flexible, digital and social culture
Flexible working hours
Working 40 hours a week
Hybrid working
Flex summer (August)
Part time working
Benefits
Yearly bonus
Home expense payment
Transportation
Life insurance
Employer sponsored pension & Family included health insurance
Special Allowances (Marriage, newborn etc.)
Meal Allowance (cash/monthly)
Leave Rights
School Report Day (Half Day) & First Day of school (Half Day)
Birthday day off
Paternity Leave – 30 days
Marriage Leave – 5 days
After 4 years of work, having extra one day annual leave each year (up to 26 days)
And there is much more!
Do the items above define you? Do you believe you can passionately and successfully carry out the tasks involved in the job description, that is the perfect match for you? Then, come and apply for the
“Fire Safety Engineer”
position.”
